jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.
 By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

We are looking for a dynamic candidate to join the Invoicing, Billing & Payments team .

Your role

You will ensure proper operational set up to perform this activity as expected by clients and management. This will include making sure organization and processes are efficient, tools are adequate and controls are in place. Acting as a point of contact for ad hoc queries of a pool of mainstream funds clients and front business lines, handling fund suppliers invoices, fund fees payments and monitoring fees budgets implemented by the funds. You will manage the funds fees payments database. You will also be involved in the preparation of fund tax declarations such as VAT, Lux & BE Subscription Tax, tantièmes.

You will guarantee service levels and consistently thrive to exceed client’s needs and expectations.

Responsibilities:

• Process Fund Suppliers invoices and funds fees payments in a timely manner according to fees calendars and invoice handling deadlines

• Monitor fund fees budgets and manage fees payments database

• Handle client queries relating to fees & payments, liaise with internal and external stakeholders involved in the invoice payment process

• Contribute to the maintenance of procedures and controls as well as the evolution of fees and payments tools to ensure transparency and risk monitoring

• Stay abreast of all internal policies and compliance to legal and regulatory requirements

• Proceed to tax declarations in compliance with the laws and in a timely manner

Your profile

Educational background and employment experience:

• Experience in funds accounting/ funds fees payments

• Good knowledge of financial products and their valuation

• Broad vision of fund administration

Specific knowledge:

• Knowledge of foreign currency hedging and asset pooling techniques is a plus

• Experience in funds accounting on Multifonds is a plus

• Fund fees payment experience

Language knowledge:

• Professional command of English and French

Personal qualities:

• Rigorous, organised and good analytical skills

• Adaptability - Can-do attitude, client centric mindset

• Sense of initiative and willing to learn

• Good communication and problem solving

• A team player who is approachable and flexible

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.description:
Your team

Pictet Alternative Advisors (PAA) is a leading alternative investment asset manager that is part of of the Pictet Group, with a focus on private equity, real estate private credit and hedge funds. Pictet Group currently has more than €50bn of AUM in alternatives and more than €25bn of private equity AUM.

Pictet launched its first direct private equity fund in 2023, with a focus on mid market European buyout investments, raising over EUR 430m. The fund operates out of London and focuses on long-term, partnership-based investments in B2B Services, Education & Training, and Industrials o across the UK and the DACH region.

You will be part of a team of 13 professionals. As the fund is now in active deployment, we are looking to expand our origination capability and hire an Origination Professional dedicated to the UK lower mid-market.

Your role

As a key member of the direct private equity team, you will be responsible for generating a consistent, high-quality pipeline of proprietary acquisition opportunities in the UK lower mid-market (£2–10m EBITDA, owner-managed businesses). The role combines direct founder outreach as well as corporate finance adviser coverage supporting the team’s thematic investment priorities, and the development of a modern origination tech stack. Your responsibilities will include:

Direct Thematic Origination:

• Conduct structured mapping of companies within sub-sectors aligned to the fund's thematic priorities;

• Run structured multi-channel outreach to founder-led businesses;

• Travel across the UK to meet entrepreneurs, qualify opportunities against investment criteria, and nurture longer-term prospects through structured CRM-driven relationship management;

• Evaluate and deploy new origination tools to scale the firm's sourcing edge.

Adviser & Intermediary Coverage:

• Build and maintain active dialogue with regional advisers, corporate finance boutiques and accountants who advise owner-managed businesses on exit;

• Travel regularly across UK regions to meet advisers, and position the fund consistently to ensure it is top of mind for upcoming sale mandates.

Your profile

• University degree from a strong institution; degree subject is secondary to drive, judgement and origination instinct.

• 7-10 years total work experience including 2-5 years in a role centred on direct, regular contact with business owners and senior decision-makers in the UK - origination, business development or cold-outreach experience is essential.

• Origination experience at a UK private equity firm or in mid-market corporate finance advisory is strongly preferred; alternative backgrounds will be considered where strong personal attributes and origination experience are present.

• Visible origination energy: a resourceful and resilient self-starter with high activity levels, comfortable with cold approaches, the phone, and regular UK travel.

• Genuine people person: builds rapport naturally with founders of owner-managed businesses, demonstrating maturity and commercial judgement, and earns trust quickly with intermediaries.

• Fluent in modern origination technology (CRM, AI tools and outreach platforms), actively curious about deploying new tools to scale proprietary sourcing.

Beyond professional skills, the ideal candidate should demonstrate hunger and smart hustle - high output paired with sharp prioritisation - alongside commercial judgement, integrity in handling sensitive founder and adviser conversations, and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving.

As the chosen candidate, you'll have the unique opportunity to join one of the world's leading private financial institutions. You'll be embedded in an ambitious direct investments team, working in a dynamic "start-up" environment while benefiting from the support of experienced senior professionals within the PAA team and the broader Pictet Group.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented in 31 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5,000 people. Pictet has been present in Singapore for more than 25 years where it employs over 200 people.

Pictet Wealth Management (PWM) combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial services group offers a comprehensive service for wealthy individuals and families, including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.

Your role

We are seeking a highly motivated Financial Analyst to join our Asia 2 team as part of a unique, structured 4-year rotational programme designed to provide a comprehensive foundation in private banking and investment management.

At the end of this programme, you will be equipped to take on the role of Private Banker, supported by a robust in-house network of specialists and an understanding of our business and clients.

This permanent position offers a 48-month journey through three key areas of our Wealth Management business, allowing you to build expertise and develop a strong professional network:

• Year 1: Immersion with Client Relationship Officers to discover client relationship management and daily operations.

• Years 2 & 3: Integration within the Investment Platform to deepen your knowledge of investment and portfolio management, and to understand the needs of portfolio managers.

• Year 4: Gaining practical experience in high-level wealth management advisory through the management of an existing client portfolio.

Throughout the programme, you will be mentored by a Senior Banker and will collaborate with professionals across the banking sector, support the implementation of wealth management strategies, and contribute to the delivery of tailored solutions for our clients. You will also have the opportunity to complete professional certifications, such as the CFA, and participate in ongoing training and development activities.

Your profile

• Master’s or Bachelor's degree in Finance or Management with 3 to 5 years of professional experience.
• Enthusiasm, interpersonal skills, and a strong interest in client relations.
• Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple projects with competing deadlines.
• Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

Die 1805 gegründete Gruppe mit Hauptsitz in Genf, Schweiz, ist in 31 Büros in Finanzzentren weltweit vertreten und beschäftigt derzeit über 5.000 Mitarbeiter. Pictet ist seit mehr als 25 Jahren in Singapur präsent und beschäftigt dort über 200 Mitarbeiter. Pictet Wealth Management (PWM) verbindet mehr als 200 Jahre Schweizer Bankerbe mit globaler Investmentexpertise. Die Partner-eigene Finanzdienstleistungsgruppe bietet einen umfassenden Service für wohlhabende Einzelpersonen und Familien, einschließlich diskretionärer und beratender Anlagelösungen und Family Office-Services. Deine Rolle Wir suchen einen hochmotivierten Finanzanalysten, der sich unserem Asia 2-Team im Rahmen eines einzigartigen, strukturierten 4-Jahres-Rotationsprogramms anschließt, das eine umfassende Grundlage im Private Banking und Investment Management bietet. Am Ende dieses Programms werden Sie in die Lage versetzt, die Rolle des Privatbankers zu übernehmen, unterstützt von einem robusten internen Netzwerk von Spezialisten und einem Verständnis für unser Geschäft und unsere Kunden. Diese feste Position bietet eine 48-monatige Reise durch drei Schlüsselbereiche unseres Wealth Management-Geschäfts, so dass Sie Fachwissen aufbauen und ein starkes professionelles Netzwerk aufbauen können:
• Jahr 1: Immersion mit Client Relationship Officers, um das Kundenbeziehungsmanagement und den täglichen Betrieb zu entdecken.
• Jahre 2 & 3: Integration in die Investmentplattform, um Ihr Wissen über Anlage- und Portfoliomanagement zu vertiefen und die Bedürfnisse von Portfoliomanagern zu verstehen.
• Jahr 4: Sammeln von praktischen Erfahrungen in der hochrangigen Vermögensverwaltung durch die Verwaltung eines bestehenden Kundenportfolios. Während des gesamten Programms werden Sie von einem Senior Banker betreut und arbeiten mit Fachleuten aus dem gesamten Bankensektor zusammen, unterstützen die Umsetzung von Vermögensverwaltungsstrategien und tragen zur Bereitstellung maßgeschneiderter Lösungen für unsere Kunden bei. • Begeisterung, zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten und ein starkes Interesse an Kundenbeziehungen.
• Hoch organisiert, detailorientiert und in der Lage, mehrere Projekte mit konkurrierenden Fristen zu verwalten.
• Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, sowohl schriftlich als auch verbal.
• Teamplayer mit einer positiven Einstellung, starker Arbeitsmoral und der Fähigkeit, sich schnell anzupassen. Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 31 offices in financial centres worldwide, currently employing over 5,000 people.

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 220 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial services group offers a comprehensive service for wealthy individuals and families, including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.

You will be joining Pictet Wealth Management Geneva and be part of the Client AML Reviewing team based there.

Mission

Performing all tasks relating to anti-money laundering (AML) with a focus on handling annual reviews for high-risk clients and PEPs.

Your role

• Performing in-depth anti-money laundering (AML) analysis for high-risk clients in application of the regulations on the fight against money laundering and the financing of terrorism (LBA, OBA-FINMA, CDB20) and presenting sensitive issues to the AML Committee.

• Performing annual PEP reviews in application of the regulations on the fight against money laundering and the financing of terrorism (LBA, OBA-FINMA, CDB20) and presenting the conclusions to the AML Committee.

Your profile

• In-depth knowledge of the financial and regulatory environment.

• Comprehensive legal knowledge relating to compliance.

• Excellent command of French and English; other languages would be a plus.

• Strong analytical mindset and problem-solving skills.

• Able to communicate precisely and distil important information.

• Conscientious.

• Able to show discretion and handle confidential issues in an appropriate manner.

• Team player.

• Proven work experience of 5 to 10 years in a similar position.

• Able to handle the material and formal aspects of KYC/KYT reviews.

Ref: BCMR/SN/ET

• Deliver optimized investment solutions to clients with a team approach.

• Profitably grow assets under management and managed solutions.

• Keep up to date with the financial markets, the Bank’s views, research and product offering across the whole firm (PWM, PAM and PAA).

• Communicate the investment platform strategy and solutions to RMs, clients and prospects.

• Meet clients and prospects together with RMs.

• Help determine clients’ needs and prepare tailor made investment proposals.

• Implement, monitor and rebalance client portfolios.

• Execute trade orders and confirm execution to clients, either directly or through Client Relationship Officers.

• Conduct risk suitability check and selling process for investment ideas initiated by investment specialist.

• Degree in Finance related subjects.

• 10 - 15 years of experience as investment specialist in multi-asset class advisory within the wealth management/private banking sector.

Your team

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial service group offers a comprehensive service for wealthy individuals and families including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.

You will build “investment partnerships” with CRMs and fellow ISs to deliver clients a unique investment experience aligned to their needs and geographical specificities. You will also assist CRMs in their business development efforts by identifying and presenting the most suitable investment solutions available and activate non-managed accounts.

Your role

• Communicating the investment platform’s strategy and solutions to CRMs, clients and prospects.
• In conjunction with the CRMs, identify and develop new business opportunities from the existing client base as well as taking part in new marketing initiatives to help convert prospects to clients.
• Help determine clients’ needs and prepare investment/advisory proposals and portfolio reviews.
• Execute trade orders and confirm execution to clients, either directly or through assistants.
• Develop, sell and retain discretionary mandates and seek to centralise their management.
• Oversee ‘advisory-type’ mandates, seeking to streamline positions and exposure and ensure they remain consistent with the bank’s overall investment strategy and policy.
• Maintain a strong compliance culture, ensuring optimal compliance and risk management by adhering to all relevant local laws, regulatory requirements, in-house directives and procedures. Acquire the appropriate knowledge to apply these effectively and ensure fair treatment of all clients, while at the same time adhering to the mission and core values of Pictet across all activities conducted with a high degree of professional competency and awareness.
These entail:
• Full understanding of Pictet’s offering, policies and guidelines, attending relevant investment forums and presentations.
• An ability to present and defend the investment philosophy and mandate/product offering.
• Regular reviews of portfolios to monitor adherence to risk controls, compliance and client constraints.
• Investment of cash positions, review of client transactions and corporate actions.
• Full understanding of attribution of own portfolio performance.
• Developing appropriate marketing material for client communication.
• Knowledge of all available marketing documents and key resources within the Group.

Your profile

• Bachelor’s degree and a post-graduate degree such as a Master’s, MBA, CIIA or CFA would be an advantage.
• At least ten years’ investment advisory/management experience; client-facing experience is a must.
• Fluency in Russian, English is required. French and Polish language skills are considered a plus in addition to the required languages.
• Excellent technical knowledge across asset classes, investment vehicles and the mandate/product offering.
• Excellent understanding of portfolio construction, investment processes and risk management approaches.
• IT-proficient, including knowledge of relevant software packages, on-line information systems, front-end management and order-placing systems (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Adobe, Bloomberg, Avaloq, Profolio, , etc.).
• Strong client-focused attitude and used to working under pressure.
• Excellent presentation skills.
• Proven team player but also able to work on one’s own.
• Cross asset class experience with solid knowledge of fixed income (EM and DM), derivatives, equities, and structured products.
• Solid understanding/experience in private equity and other alternative investments.
• Experience and understanding of thematic equities would be a strong advantage.
• Ability to explain complex concepts in simple terms.

We are an independent investment partnership known for our long-term mindset, responsible approach to business, and entrepreneurial spirit. These principles have defined us since 1805. For our clients, colleagues and wider society, we always aim to do the right thing and honour our commitment to enduring quality.

Pictet opened its Tokyo office in 1981 to conduct research on the Japanese economy and equity market. It began providing asset management services to institutional investors in 1987 and entered the investment trust (mutual fund) business in 1997. As of the end of March 2026, the firm’s assets under management totaled 4.56 trillion yen.

Your role

We are seeking an economist to lead our global research and analysis on macroeconomics, monetary policy, interest rates, and foreign exchange.

Key responsibilities include preparing reports and presentation materials on macroeconomic and financial market developments; delivering presentations to retail and institutional investors, financial institutions, and the media; and providing clear explanations and interpretive support during client meetings.

The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills and excellent communication abilities, with the proven ability to convey complex information effectively in both English and Japanese.

• Conduct in-depth analysis of macroeconomic trends, monetary policy, interest rates, and foreign exchange in Japan and globally

• Prepare reports and presentation materials for both internal and external stakeholders

• Deliver presentations to retail and institutional investors, financial institutions, and the media

• Provide clear explanations and interpretation support during client meetings

Your profile

• Bachelor’s degree or higher

• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience as an economist

• Deep understanding of macroeconomics and financial markets

• Native-level proficiency in Japanese and business-level or higher proficiency in English (reading, writing, and speaking)

• Excellent report writing and presentation skills

• Demonstrated experience in client-facing roles

jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Corporate Functions includes the Group’s non-banking activities and employs more than 600 people. These functions are carried out by specialists with expertise across all business units, and include Communications, Compliance, Finance, Human Resources, Information Security, Internal Audit, Legal, Organisation & Digital, Risk and Tax departments.

The Corporate Compliance Officer participates in monitoring the company's activities to ensure compliance with applicable regulations and also takes part in the implementation of the CMP (Control Monitoring Plan). He also ensures the strengthening of the company's procedural and training framework.

Your role

• Analyze regulatory watch screenings performing gap analysis on new regulations and assess their potential impact within the company.

• Contribute to the development and implementation of the Compliance Monitoring Plan by identifying applicable compliance standards and monitoring controls using a risk-based approach.

• Identify and assess compliance risks to which the company is exposed, make appropriate observations, and verify appropriate follow up on related to identified issues with the different stakeholders.

• Assist in establishing and maintaining a compliance manual, ensuring that all internal policies and procedures comply with legal requirements and group minimum standards.

• Assist in the training of new employees on compliance topics and ensure that compliance training is conducted at defined intervals.

• Participate in regulatory projects by providing advice on legal requirements and ensuring that delivered solutions comply with regulations and minimum group standards.

• Maintain and update various registers, including investor complaints, conflicts of interest, personal transactions, gifts, and identified issues.

• Follow up on audit recommendations and participate in the proper implementation.

• Collaborate with regulators and the Ministry of Finance to ensure compliance and respond to regulatory requests.

Your profile

Request experience:

• Bachelor or Master degree in compliance, legal or related field.

• 3 to 5 years of experience in a equivalent role.

Technical skills:

• Good knowledge of European and Luxembourgish regulations.

• Understanding of the operational mechanisms of a management company and the associated regulatory framework.

• Good knowledge of the industry of Fund and Asset Management.

• Ability to perform controls. Former experience on audit (external or internal) is a plus.

• Written and oral communication skills.

Soft skills:

• Discretion, rigor, and reliability.

• Analytical skills and critical thinking.

• Good organizational and priority management skills.

• Ability to navigate complex and constantly evolving environments

Language skills:

• French: fluent

• English: fluent

Note

We will not accept any CVs from agencies.

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

Flexible and modern ways of working

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave.

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.
